transcript: Ishaan, I'm 20, and I have no idea what skill to learn. There are three skills that will absolutely elevate you as a person. Number one, learn how to communicate effectively and have great conversations with people. There's a book called The Art of the Witty Banter that you can read for that. Isse you will learn ki aap logon ke saath masti kaise kar sakte ho baat karke. Number two, learn the skill of selling yourself. You are always negotiating and selling things to other people, and if you don't know how to sell effectively, you will always be utilized and you will always be used by other people. And aakhri skill, which I think is super underrated, is this thing called metacognition, which is the ability for you to think about your own thoughts. Every day, you are being brainwashed by Instagram, by YouTube, by ads, by political leaders, and you don't know about it. Aap bas bhed-bakri ki tarah you are being led to something that someone else decided. Know how to think about your own thinking. So when you can analyze how you are behaving, what patterns are you repeating, you can then learn to fix it yourself. And agar aap ye kar loge na 20 ki age mein, you can pretty much become unstoppable and unrecognizable in the next four years.
